subject: Close Plan: security gating calendar, DPA retention carveouts, and evidence runway (Tidelake)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Rivera <emma.rivera@tidelake.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff — security gating items & proposed evidence windows

Emma —

Thanks for the call earlier. Per our conversation I put together a short MAP-focused plan just for the security/compliance gating so we can align on what needs to land for your procurement team and legal sign-off. High level: SOC 2 readiness items, SIG/CAIQ responses, DPA carveouts and the explicit data retention windows you flagged.

Quick asks from your side so we can finalize the timeline:
- Confirm which SIG controls you want completed vs informational (i.e., do you need implementation evidence for CC6.1/CC7.0?).
- Confirm desired retention period for transaction logs and embeddings (you mentioned a 7-year regulatory requirement for a subset — is that accurate for the pilot customer set?).
- Any specific DPA carveouts your legal team intends to propose (e.g., audit access, subprocessor list cadence).

I've attached a one-page MAP timeline and an initial SIG response export — see files attached. Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Week 1 (Nov 9–13): SIG clarifications + DPA redline back
- Week 2 (Nov 16–20): Evidence collection (SOC 2 controls owner sign-off)
- Week 3 (Nov 23–27): Exec review + final DPA and DocuSign prep

If that works, Marcus will own the implementation evidence bucket and Jasmine will coordinate the DPA redline. I'll track the decision items in the MAP doc and share a HubSpot card.

Thanks — feel free to flag anything missing.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: MAP_Timeline_Tidelake.xlsx, Tidelake_SIG_Responses.pdf
From: Emma Rivera <emma.rivera@tidelake.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@tidelake.com, Alex Green <alex.green@tidelake.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gating items & proposed evidence windows

Neha —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few clarifications from legal/security here before we lock dates:

1) Retention: our compliance group requires a 7-year retention for settlement records, but embeddings/derived vectors can be retained for up to 2 years unless explicitly linked to PII. We need Redwood to confirm support for per-data-class retention policies (per-MAP preference), not global only.

2) SIG: we'll mark the majority as "implementation + evidence" for network and access controls. For some application-level controls we may accept architecture diagrams and remediation timelines instead of immediate evidence. I'll send a prioritized control list by EOD.

3) DPA: our counsel will push a narrow carveout around forensic data copies (they prefer a monthly subprocessor list rather than quarterly) — I'll attach the redline.

Can Marcus confirm that log export for settlement flows can be scoped to a 7-year archive (S3 Glacier) and that keys can be separated per-customer? Also: do you have an SLA exception item for log export latency during incident response?

Emma
Emma Rivera
Head of Procurement, Tidelake Capital
emma.rivera@tidelake.com

Attachments: Tidelake_DPA_redline_v1.docx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Rivera <emma.rivera@tidelake.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gating items & proposed evidence windows

Emma / Neha —

Short answers to the two engineering asks:

- Per-customer key separation: supported. We can provision KMS CMKs scoped to Tidelake and rotate per your cadence; we will document key-rotation owners in the MAP.
- 7-year archive: supported via lifecycle rules to Glacier Deep Archive. We'll need a signed DPA that permits long-term storage and identifies the retention class; operationally we will export settlement logs to a dedicated bucket and apply the lifecycle.
- SLA exception for log export latency: we can add an incident-response SLA clause (e.g., 2-hour access window for security investigations) but that is an exception to our standard data retrieval SLOs and will need to be captured as an addendum.

Action items I'm taking:
1) Produce a short tech appendix describing per-customer KMS, bucket naming, and retention enforcement (target delivery: Nov 13).
2) Confirm export latency limits and propose wording for the incident-response SLA exception (target delivery: Nov 16).

Jasmine — I'll hand the DPA redline notes to you for legal coordination.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Product Operations — Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Rivera <emma@tidelake.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gating items & proposed evidence windows

Emma —

Thanks for the DPA redline. I reviewed the carveout around forensic copies and the monthly subprocessor cadence. Proposed counter: we can accept monthly subprocessor disclosure but request a 30-day notice window for any materially new subprocessor added to the settlement pipeline; for forensic copies, suggest limited-scope access under NDA for audit requests only.

I've uploaded a redline (DPA_Carveouts_redline.docx) with comments and a short digest of open items. Key MAP milestones (updated):
- Nov 13: Technical appendix + prioritized SIG control list (Marcus)
- Nov 16: Incident-response SLA wording + DPA counterproposal (Jasmine)
- Nov 18: Evidence handoff package (SOC 2 owner confirmations, screenshots, architecture diagrams)
- Nov 20: Legal & procurement sign-off window
- Nov 23: DocuSign package ready (final DPA + SOW)

If any of those dates are problematic for you, flag now. We'll keep the MAP card in HubSpot for visibility.

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
jasmine@redwood.ai

Attachment: DPA_Carveouts_redline.docx
From: Emma Rivera <emma.rivera@tidelake.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gating items & proposed evidence windows

Team —

All looks reasonable. Counsels did a quick pass and accepted the monthly subprocessor cadence. They asked us to add the 30-day notice language you suggested, Jasmine — that’s fine. On retention: confirmed 7 years for settlement logs; 24 months for embeddings unless opt-in for extended retention (we'll provide list of opt-ins by Nov 18).

Next steps for close:
- Please upload the tech appendix and SIG priority list to the shared MAP doc by COB Nov 13 (Marcus).
- Jasmine to send final DPA counter by Nov 16 and I'll route to our counsel for final sign-off.
- Once DPA is green, we'll accept the DocuSign link and aim to sign by Nov 24.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Rivera
Head of Procurement, Tidelake Capital
emma.rivera@tidelake.com

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/some/fake-link/TLK-2026-04
